raw.rationale: This compound is a launched antihypertensive imidazoline/alpha2-adrenergic agonist with no known cytotoxic or anticancer mechanism, and PRISM single-concentration viability screens of such non-oncology drugs typically show no lineage-selective killing above base rates. Therefore probabilities are set near the low end of the stated 0.2-2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation reflecting lineage size and known alpha2-adrenergic/off-target expression differences.
